_comment: Unlike export, D365 import of a small package is synchronous enough to run as one job -- no separate poll job. If your import volume needs async status polling too, mirror export-poll's pattern (see docs/drasi-integration.md) rather than adding a blocking loop here.

steps._comment: sourceBlobNames is an explicit list, not a live container listing -- see blob_archive's module doc for why. This step's output also carries the archive as base64 content for upload-package below.

config.url: <carried forward from get-write-url's response.value -- see runbook>

steps._comment: Reads zip-package's base64 output automatically (it's the immediately preceding step). url must be supplied here explicitly since get-write-url is two steps back, not one -- there is no fan-out/multi-step-back lookup in this platform's data flow model.
